name: Masked Min/Max
description: Port of FFmpeg's maskedmin and maskedmax filters: per channel, pick the filter clip closest to (min) or farthest from (max) the source.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: Source clip the other two are compared with

inputs.name: filter1
inputs.description: First filter clip (same size as the source)

inputs.name: filter2
inputs.description: Second filter clip (same size as the source)

params.name: mode
params.description: 0 = maskedmin (closest to the source), 1 = maskedmax (farthest from the source)
